THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE PRODUCE

Two names.
One commitment.

J is for Joseph. O is for Owura.
And everything we do is for growth.

J&O Farm Produce Ltd means Joseph & Owura Farm Produce Ltd. Founded by two brothers in agribusiness, our story begins with a shared belief in what Ghana’s land can make possible.

As Joint Chief Executive Officers, Mr. Joseph Ocloo and Mr. Owura (Edward Appiah-Dwomoh) lead our integrated farm in Ankwensu, in the Eastern Region.

We rear our own livestock, grow our own crops, mill our own feed, and import genuine fertilizer. Real farming is at the heart of our business.
